evals.name: digital-pdf-to-markdown
evals.prompt: Wyciagnij tekst z pliku fixture/digital_note.pdf do markdowna, zebym mogl go potem przeszukiwac - zalezy mi zwlaszcza na liczbach z tabeli twardosci.
evals.expected_output: A .md file containing the report text and the hardness numbers, produced via the skill's script.
assertions: A .md file was produced and is non-empty
The markdown contains the heading text 'Cooling Test Report No. 7'
The markdown contains the hardness values 198, 172 and 161
The conversion was done with scripts/pdf_to_md.py, not by reading the PDF directly
The hardness table is rendered as a Markdown table, not as a run-on paragraph

evals.name: scanned-pdf-needs-full-ocr
evals.prompt: this pdf seems to be a scan - when i open it there is no selectable text at all. can you get the text out of fixture/scan_note.pdf?
evals.expected_output: Non-empty markdown obtained with --full-ocr, plus a caveat that OCR digits may be misread.
assertions: The script was invoked with --full-ocr (either directly or after an empty first attempt)
The resulting markdown is non-empty and contains 'Cooling Test Report'
The reply flags that OCR transcription of numbers/units is not fully reliable

evals.name: figure-extraction-to-directory
evals.prompt: Potrzebuje z tego raportu wyciagnac wykres jako osobny plik png, plus tekst - fixture/digital_note.pdf
evals.expected_output: Run with --images; output in its own directory with <stem>.md plus <stem>_artifacts/ PNGs.
assertions: At least one PNG was written into a <stem>_artifacts/ directory
The reply states where the .md and the _artifacts/ directory landed, and how many figures were extracted

evals.name: summarize-from-markdown
evals.prompt: Streszcz mi ten raport i podaj gradient twardosci: fixture/digital_note.pdf
evals.expected_output: Converts to Markdown with the skill's script first, then summarizes from the Markdown and cites it.
assertions: The PDF is converted with the skill's script before summarizing
The summary cites the generated .md file rather than the PDF
The reported hardness gradient is 37 HV10

evals.name: negative-trigger-pdf-generation
evals.prompt: Mam gotowy raport w markdownie (raport.md) - zrob mi z niego ladny PDF do wyslania klientowi, z naglowkiem firmy na pierwszej stronie.
evals.expected_output: The read-pdf skill should NOT be used; this is PDF generation, which the description explicitly excludes.
assertions: The read-pdf skill is not invoked
No call to scripts/pdf_to_md.py is made
